permission.desc: Browser needs permission to re-access folder {folder} to play audio.

player.errorFormat: Cannot play this audio file (unsupported format or corrupted file)
player.largeFileNotice: Large file (>20MB) — Skipping waveform · Click to seek

welcome.headline:
Listen by sentence.
Transcribe every word.
welcome.description: Select an audio folder to listen continuously, loop each sentence, and control playback with your keyboard. Everything runs locally on your machine—no uploads.
welcome.formatsHint: Supports mp3, m4a, and common audio formats
welcome.feature1Desc: Configure repetition count and pause duration so you have time to write before the next sentence.
welcome.feature2Desc: Play, seek, switch files, and adjust speed without taking your hands off the keyboard.
welcome.feature3Desc: Reopen anytime to continue right from the last file, with starred difficult sentences saved.
welcome.safariDesc: This browser cannot remember folder handles, so you need to pick your folder each session. Settings and last played file are preserved. Use Chrome to auto-remember folders.

reset.dialogDesc: Settings, folder session, listening history, and stars will be cleared from this browser. Your local audio files will not be modified.
